title: IBM Cloud Pak for Integration
content:
## Overview

### 

An AI-powered integration 

IBM Cloud Pak for Integration is a container-native, self-managed platform that unifies APIs, events, messaging, files, and applications under a single control plane. With AI across the lifecycle, teams gain consistency, observability and architectural control – without sacrificing speed or flexibility.​

## Features

One platform. Every integration.

### 

Build automated flows instantly with no-code, AI-powered integration

Easily build flows with no-code integration tools, pre-built templates and connectors for the most common business apps, and AI that automatically performs time-intensive, complex tasks with App Connect.​

![Screenshot of IBM App Connect Enterprise Toolkit interface](https://assets.ibm.com/is/image/ibm/IBM-App-Connect-Enterprise-Toolkit?ts=1791549227118&dpr=off)

### 

Create, manage, and secure your APIs from a single, unified platform

Create, secure, manage and socialize APIs within a single, unified experience. Accelerate the API lifecycle and improve the quality of your APIs with new insights from automated testing  with API Connect.​

![API Connect demo UI screenshot](https://assets.ibm.com/is/image/ibm/api-connect-demo-thumbnail-v3?ts=1791549228488&dpr=off "IBM API Connect interface with workflow diagram")

### 

Respond to customer needs in real time with event-driven automation

Become highly responsive to changes in the world. Replace manual workflows with a series of automatic actions that address customer needs in real time, triggered by internal or external events with Event Streams.​

![Screenshot of IBM Cloud Monitor on IBM Event Streams platform dashboard](https://assets.ibm.com/is/image/ibm/ibm-event-streams-monitoring-1?ts=1791549229833&dpr=off)

### 

Transfer and stream data of any size at high speeds across any cloud

Utilize high-speed data migration transfers to, from and between on-premise data centers and any major cloud. Deliver data of any size and virtually unlimited bit-rate video with Aspera.​

![Product screenshot showing Transfer activity](https://assets.ibm.com/is/image/ibm/transfer-visibility?ts=1791549231249&dpr=off "Data transfer activity dashboard overview")

### 

Preserve data integrity with reliable, once-only message delivery

Preserve data integrity by preventing outages and ensuring mission-critical data is delivered reliably only once with MQ.​

![IBM MQ screenshot relating to simple universal connectivity](https://assets.ibm.com/is/image/ibm/mq-simple-universal-connectivity?ts=1791549232668&dpr=off "Queue Manager Dashboard with Metrics Display")

### 

Enterprise-grade security

Integrate across any cloud provider and deploy and scale with cloud-native architecture, all with end-to-end enterprise-grade security and encryption with Datapower Gateway.​

![Screenshot of Data Power Nano Gateway UI dashboard](https://assets.ibm.com/is/image/ibm/dpng-overview-image?ts=1791549234841&dpr=off "IBM API Connect analytics dashboard overview")
